requirements.quote: Settings UI to link a WhatsApp number (OTP), choose message categories and unlink
with a server action per operation
an i18n namespace in en/kn/ta with catalog test
Settings UI to link a WhatsApp number (OTP)
requirements.why: Delivering the OTP over WhatsApp needs a provider-approved OTP template (WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES in packages/notifications/src/channels/whatsapp.ts has none) and a sendOtp sender; template approval is a provider action. Follow-up: add OTP template and wire sendOtp into the request action.

deliverables.change: 'use server' module with requestWhatsAppOtpAction({workspaceId,e164,consent}), verifyWhatsAppOtpAction({workspaceId,code}), setWhatsAppCategoriesAction({workspaceId,categories}), unlinkWhatsAppAction({workspaceId}), getWhatsAppLinkAction({workspaceId}), each built with workspaceAction + WorkspaceScoped, calling @causedeck/core/whatsapp-link with {db: ctx.tx} and actor {userId: ctx.userId, workspaceId: ctx.workspaceId} (never a user from input); domain errors mapped to ActionError via domainErrorCode (NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, CONFLICT, VALIDATION, RATE_LIMITED if the ActionError codes include it, else map to the nearest); exports only async functions plus types; returned view has the masked number only

client component: number input + consent checkbox -> request code; code input -> verify; when linked show masked number, category checkboxes limited to WHATSAPP_CATEGORIES (@causedeck/notifications/whatsapp) and an unlink button; all strings from useTranslations('whatsappLink'); actions passed as props
load the caller's link with inWorkspace (@causedeck/core/runtime) + getWhatsAppLink, render the card below the preferences (error state: card shows retry/message, page still renders)
new namespace file, single top-level key whatsappLink (title, description, consent, number, send code, code, verify, categories labels, unlink, errors, masked-number text)
add 'whatsappLink' to the expected top-level keys and a test that en/ta/kn have the whatsappLink keys
regenerate with pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n i18n:types (also kn.json, ta.json, messages.d.ts in the same directory)

import the new actions module, add the five actions to ACTIONS and probe inputs, add a 'under B's own workspace' test: request+verify (fixed code is not injectable, so insert via core with generateCode or assert request/get/setCategories/unlink only touch ub's rows in B) and A's snapshot unchanged; extend snapshotA if it does not cover whatsapp tables
new unit test mirroring notification-preferences-actions.test.ts: user comes from the session never the input, non-member FORBIDDEN, error mapping, consent required
new jsdom test of the card: request, verify, set categories, unlink, error states, en/ta/kn strings
only if the page test breaks: mock getWhatsAppLink/inWorkspace for the page render

preserve.what: Existing notification preference actions and exports in apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/settings/notifications/actions.ts (names, inputs, behaviour) and the PushPermissionCard placement on that page

@causedeck/core/whatsapp-link public API and D-029 rule: a message target is only ever the owner's verified number (packages/core/src/whatsapp-link/link.ts); do not change core, db or the notification sender
No full phone number is returned to the client: only WhatsAppLinkView.maskedNumber

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n exec vitest run src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts src/__tests__/check-catalogs.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}

decisions.choice: Put the card on the existing notifications settings page instead of a new settings section
decisions.justification: settings-nav.ts has fixed section lists plus nav i18n and shell tests; the push card already sits on this page (settings/notifications/page.tsx), so no nav change is needed

decisions.choice: Actions live in a separate whatsapp-actions.ts next to the page
decisions.justification: A 'use server' module exports only async functions; nested per-feature action files exist (settings/integrations/email/actions.ts); cross-tenant test imports each module

decisions.choice: Request action passes no sendOtp; OTP delivery deferred (R5)
decisions.justification: link.ts:32 makes sendOtp optional; channels/whatsapp.ts:18 has no OTP template

decisions.choice: Use new namespace whatsapp-link with top-level key whatsappLink
decisions.justification: catalog.ts:7 NAMESPACES convention (whatsapp-import -> whatsappImport); mergeNamespaces rejects duplicate top-level keys

decisions.choice: No new workspace package dependency: apps/web already depends on @causedeck/core and @causedeck/notifications
decisions.justification: existing imports in settings/notifications/actions.ts and page.tsx
